## Project Name
TeachFund Stream

## One-Line Description
Milestone-based teacher training crowdfunding where Stellar escrow unlocks grants after verified learning outcomes.

## Track
Track 5 Social Impact

## Problem It Solves
Teacher development funds often arrive late and lack transparent proof of completion. TeachFund Stream connects donor pledges to verified learning milestones and releases Stellar payments when outcomes are recorded.

## How It Uses Stellar
TeachFund Stream uses Freighter wallet signing, Stellar testnet, XLM SAC escrow transfers, Soroban RPC, and a Rust Soroban contract named TeachFundStream. Uses Freighter and XLM SAC for donor pledges, Soroban for course milestones, and an x402-style quote endpoint for paid training resources.
